about.title: About Fatih
about.description1: I'm {age}, an architecture student from Sarajevo in my fourth year of studies. Before university I trained and worked as an architectural technician, so I learned how buildings are put together before I learned how to design them.
about.description2: I've worked on residential, commercial and urban projects, spent seven months in a design studio and seen more than ten of my projects built. I approach every project with precision, curiosity and a commitment to meaningful spaces.

services.title: My Services
services.description: From the first sketch to the final render, I cover the whole design process for homes, offices and interiors.

items.title: Architectural Design
items.description: Homes, offices and mixed-use buildings designed from the first sketch to a buildable plan.

items.title: Interior Design
items.description: Kitchens, bedrooms and living spaces that are comfortable, functional and built around the client.

items.title: 3D Visualization
items.description: Photoreal renders that show the light, materials and mood of a project before it is built.

tools.title: Tools I Work With
tools.description: From construction drawings to final renders, I work across the full digital workflow, from the first line to the finished image.
tools.next: What's next: finish my studies, gain experience in a respected firm, and one day lead a practice of my own.
